list_files: List direct children of a workspace directory; paths are workspace-relative.
write_file: Create or replace a UTF-8 workspace file.
delete_file: Delete one regular workspace file. Always requires user confirmation.
Bash: Run an exact policy-approved simple command in a workspace-relative cwd.
complete_task: Complete current task with runtime-verified evidence from its saved tool call; call this alone.
submit_plan: Submit the structured plan and stop for explicit user approval.
submit_tasks: Submit tasks with dependencies and required verification tools; wait for explicit approval.
